reports.title: Absci Reports Business Updates and Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Operating Results

desk.headline: Loss of $0.19 a share, slightly better than estimates; hair-loss trial data due in December; no financial guidance
results: Partner revenue was small at $0.3m, down from $0.4m a year ago and below the estimate.
The net loss widened to $33.3m from $28.7m as research spending on ABS-201 rose to $23.6m; the loss per share fell to $0.19 from $0.20 because there are more shares.
Cash and investments fell to $173.7m from $201.1m in June; Absci still expects this to last into the second half of 2028.
ABS-201 for pattern hair loss is dosing patients in the multiple-dose part of the HEADLINE trial, with 13-week interim data due in December 2026 and full 26-week data in early 2027.
Absci set out plans for a roughly 150-patient Phase 2 endometriosis trial (STORYLINE), expected to start in mid-2027, and hired ex-Galderma executive Gerry Muhle as Chief Commercial Officer.

guidance.summary: Absci gives no revenue or earnings guidance. It expects its cash to fund operations into the second half of 2028 and lists trial milestones: hair-loss interim data in December 2026, full data in early 2027 and an endometriosis Phase 2 start in mid-2027.

watch: The 13-week interim hair-loss results from the HEADLINE trial, due in December 2026.
